recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a build-scoped stale model metadata property and intentionally leaves unrelated British-spelled terminology codes and spelling-dictionary entries untouched.
issue_request: FHIR-31858 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core MedicinalProduct technical correction asking that paediatricUseIndicator use US spelling, with resolution text to change paediatric to pediatric.
initial_application: The issue had already been partially applied by Jira-tagged commits bf8fbdc130175517adbf67966872d11bf096d806 and aa2f228c821b96e4c0fc79e1c815d97ce6997050, which renamed the MedicinalProductDefinition StructureDefinition element id/path and mapping text. The FHIR model definition Library content still exposed paediatricUseIndicator.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps both Library and MedicinalProductDefinition in the current build, and publish.ini publishes source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml. The current authoritative StructureDefinition uses MedicinalProductDefinition.pediatricUseIndicator. Zulip and Confluence searches found no community discussion or minutes changing the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml so the FHIR model definition element name is pediatricUseIndicator, matching the current StructureDefinition and Jira decision.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: renamed the model info element from paediatricUseIndicator to pediatricUseIndicator.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the second historical FHIR-31858 implementation commit, but it concerned packaged product references and was not needed to decide this spelling fix.
